name: Pipes of Haunting
description: A set of bone pipes that sound like distant screaming.
body:
## What they do

They hold three charges and regain 1d3 each dawn. If you can play wind instruments, spend one as an action to play a tune that terrifies: each creature within 30 feet that hears it makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or is frightened of you for a minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. You can let those not hostile to you pass, and one that succeeds is safe from the pipes for a day.

features.name: Haunting
features.text: Spend a charge: creatures within 30 feet that hear it make a DC 15 Wisdom save or are frightened of you for a minute. Needs proficiency with wind instruments.
